## Summary

Full Stack Developer experienced in building enterprise CRM and operational
systems with Laravel and React, with a background in manufacturing and warehouse
digitalization on top of legacy ERP environments (Infor/Baan). Skilled in REST API
design, role-based access systems, AI feature integration, inventory traceability,
and modern component-based frontend architectures.

## Education

## Experience

### Full Stack Developer — PT Data Teknologi Terintegrasi (Jun 2026 – Present, Jakarta)
- Develops VALAK CRM, an actuarial consulting CRM platform, using Laravel 12 and
  React 19 across authentication, master data, calculation, and reporting modules.
- Built role-based dashboards and task/todo management views for admin, sales (AM),
  marketing, data, actuary, and finance roles, including an internal dashboard for
  the actuarial team.
- Developed calculation submission and progress-tracking features, integrating
  calculation APIs and per-PIC company dropdown endpoints into the frontend workflow.
- Integrated AI-powered summary insights (Kimi AI for NirmaAI) and a data-labeling
  API for role-based document management.
- Implemented core platform modules: login, PIC management, group management CRUD,
  client–group linking, revision-note chatroom for report review, and project
  ID/number administration APIs.

### Full Stack Developer / System Engineer Intern — PT Gemala Kempa Daya, Astra Otoparts Group (Feb 2025 – Jun 2026, Jakarta)
- Developed a FIFO-based floor-storage warehouse monitoring system supporting 48
  material blocks and 400+ weekly transactions with QR gate in/out, digital block
  visualization, and supply scheduling — reducing material search cycle time by
  76.10% from 103.00 to 24.62 minutes (validated via work measurement / time study).
- Built a finished goods warehouse visualization system for Giant Rack Plant 3,
  mapping 80+ rack columns across multi-layer, top, and side U-shape storage layouts
  with customer filtering, barcode scanning, shipment status tracking, and operator
  guidance.
- Built inventory aging and LMB reporting modules for accounting reconciliation,
  supporting 30,000+ row multi-sheet Excel exports in around 9 seconds with
  drill-down tracing from warehouse summary to transaction details.
- Designed Smart Andon maintenance monitoring with QR validation, lifecycle
  tracking, technician activity monitoring, and MTTR visibility.
- Developed maintenance cost approval workflows integrating sparepart usage, COA
  classification, asset submission, and multi-level approval tracking between
  Maintenance and Accounting.
- Executed a phased Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration for the Trucking Control System
  using an application-level dual-write strategy, maintaining zero downtime during
  live production operations.

### Web Developer — Nirmala Technology (Aug 2024 – Jan 2025, Jakarta)
- Developed client web applications including a QR-based restaurant ordering system
  with cart, checkout, order tracking, Midtrans payment webhook, and admin dashboard.
- Built coliving and cafe event booking modules with room/event availability,
  deposit payment via Midtrans, payment status polling, webhook handling, email
  notification, and role-based admin CMS.
- Developed a bilingual corporate profile platform using Laravel 11 and engineered
  responsive, component-based UI architectures for Q-Tin Dashboard using DaisyUI
  and Flowbite.
